IMPORTANT CAVEAT: LJFS has a secondary phase but, per its own site, no sixth form / post-16 provision — students leave after GCSEs, so there is no in-house Israel gap-year advisor role. Headteacher is the most relevant named contact for a general enquiry, but this school doesn't cleanly meet the brief's 'post-16' criterion.

Significant caveats: this school has no sixth form (enrolls boys only to age ~15-16 per Ofsted) and, per its Ofsted report, has no official website at all — email was sourced from the Charity Commission register, not a school-controlled page.
